## Overview

LRPAL01d is the **dose sensitivity variant** of [LRPAL01](../lrp-rli-al-001/) for word reading (`ewrswr`): the same endpoint-score regression over onset-aligned windows, with the cumulative sessions delivered over the aligned window added as a covariate (`gamma_dose`).

**Dose sensitivity.** Sessions received are affected by assignment and by characteristics that can also predict the outcome. Conditioning on dose can therefore introduce bias. Read `gamma_dose` as an adjusted dose association. The cohort contrast also remains an association because the windows differ in age, timing and length.

## Model

$$
W_{\text{post(aligned)}} \sim \operatorname{BetaBinomial}(n, \operatorname{expit}(\eta), \kappa),\quad
\eta = \alpha + \beta_{\text{cohort}}\,\text{immediate}
  + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(W_{\text{onset}})
  + \gamma_A A_{\text{onset,std}} + \gamma_{\text{ability}}z(\text{blocks})
  + \gamma_{\text{dose}}z(\text{sessions}).
$$

One row per child (no random intercept). Priors follow the shared template in `priors.py`.
